answers.core: It is a core feature to disallow such nodes being used
answers.workaround:
How many lines of code required would depend on the extended node, but in my case it would require re-implementation of all features in the range class as well as the slider class, but also not be able to be a drop in replacement because of the base node mismatch.

Overall I would say, no it can not be worked around easily.

title: Allow plugins to extend virtual nodes
